answer: Exclusive shard custody is the scarce resource: each identity holds one distinct 3 GB shard of a shale archive, assigned by hashing its key with the onyx checkpoint, live for the full epoch. Audit probes wander across blocks; holders return keyed hashes of named blocks within 300 milliseconds. Auditors recompute the hashes from the assignment record; a wrong or late block, or one shard answering for two keys, is proof and suspends the identity. An honest agent stores 3 GB once; 1,000 fakes store 3 TB, since key-derived shards never overlap and cannot be deduplicated or shared.
